Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence with the precisely timed shots below. Preserve each referenced identity, body proportions, costume and rigid handmade mask. Masks stay fixed to the head with stable features and eye openings; emotion is performed through the body, eyes where visible, breath and hands. All characters are adults. Each listed cut changes the specified physical camera position, lens or viewpoint. Handheld movement responds to the actor and follows a possible path in the set; keep the key action readable and focus engaged. Use hard cuts at listed shot boundaries. References anchor design; the written lighting defines exposure and illumination. Preserve the tactile Iranian-inspired world and restrained natural exposure.

LOCATION AND LIGHT
Enclosed preparation room with a NORTH main door, EAST work counter and WEST narrow service exit. One hard neutral ceiling practical and weak warmer west-wall spill illuminate a continuous level floor. Old Iranian masonry, rounded openings and engineered lamps. Keep fixed exposure and light direction across all angles. A plain low wooden work stool stands near the central floor. The west service exit leads into a person-width passage, then a low constriction and a rear building outlet onto open ground. Sparse recessed cold utility lights leave deep intervals of darkness; cool predawn sky becomes visible only near the exterior outlet. The city stays behind the fugitive; mountains lie ahead.

START STATE AND BLOCKING
Preparation room: Older sits center-left on the low stool facing south, Armayil stands behind him and slightly east/right. Garmayil is off camera near the kitchen access. One preparation knife rests on the east counter. Separate passage: Younger alone wears his fastened escape robe and moves away from the palace room toward the rear outlet. Cuts alternate these two spaces; each keeps its own illumination.


SHOT 08A | 0s to 4s | 4 seconds
50mm handheld close from southwest at Older’s seated eye height. Older is foreground left, Armayil behind/right. Older’s hands shake against his knees; he breathes rapidly, then deliberately bows his masked head to make the task easier for Armayil. Camera eases closer with the bow. Armayil remains visibly reluctant behind him.

SHOT 08B | 4s to 7s | 3 seconds
24mm close from a small widening ahead of Younger in the narrow passage. He faces camera and advances toward it, turns one shoulder sideways through a constriction and drags the robe clear with his hand. Camera backs a single step in the available space, brushing close to the wall. He is crying and exhausted; his movement has real friction.

SHOT 08C | 7s to 12s | 5 seconds
50mm close oblique view from southeast of the stool. Older remains seated left foreground, head bowed; Armayil right/rear faces his back. Armayil has taken the knife in his right hand from the nearby east counter. His left hand trembles, then settles gently on the crown/back of Older’s rigid mask, steadying his lowered head. Armayil’s right wrist begins lifting the knife beside his own torso. Camera advances a few centimeters toward the shaking hand. Cut while the blade is still separated from Older; the fatal action occurs entirely in the omitted interval.

SHOT 08D | 12s to 15s | 3 seconds
35mm tight handheld from behind Younger within the passage. His back fills center frame as he squeezes through a low opening, catches his robe on the edge and pulls free. Camera ducks with him. Sound is his breathing and cloth against stone; the hidden event in the other room has no accompanying sound.

END STATE AND EDIT
Younger continues toward the exterior, unaware of the precise moment inside the room. The last view of Older was seated with head bowed and Armayil’s left hand gently on his mask. A deliberate time ellipsis leads to the kitchen task; the act itself remains off-screen.

SOUND
Broken breathing in the room; trembling clothing and a light hand touching the mask. On passage shots, close sobs, foot scrapes and fabric against masonry. The omitted act is silent.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

END PROMPT
